test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select ‘No substitution required’.

The students **was asked** **to submit their assignments** by Friday.

options.text: are asked to submitted their assignments
were asked to submit their assignments
will asked to submit their assignments

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence contains a grammatical error in the verb agreement. The subject "**students**" is plural, but the verb "**was**" is singular, leading to a mismatch.
 
• In the correct sentence, "**were**" is used as the appropriate auxiliary verb to match the plural subject "**students**."
 
• Additionally, the correct infinitive "**to submit**" is used after "**were asked**." 
 
• The corrected sentence ensures proper subject-verb agreement and grammatical clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The students **were asked to submit their assignments** by Friday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "are asked to submitted their assignments"** – This option is incorrect because "are asked" is in the present tense, and "submitted" is a grammatically incorrect form of the verb.
 
• **Option 2: "No substitution required"** – This is incorrect because the original sentence contains a subject-verb agreement error.
 
• **Option 4: "will asked to submit their assignments"** – This is incorrect because "will asked" is grammatically incorrect; it should be "will be asked."
